question: Should this Zalo sanitizer PR wait for live Zalo delivery proof, or may maintainers override the proof gate and merge on focused tests plus sibling-channel precedent?
rationale: The code path is narrow and source-backed, but external PR policy requires real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally accepts the remaining delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

options.title: Accept Unit-Only Proof
options.body: Merge on the small diff, focused tests, and sibling-channel precedent while accepting that real Zalo delivery behavior remains unproven until after merge.

recommendation.title: Require Live Zalo Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live Zalo transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing the trace line stripped and ordinary text preserved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history in the Zalo adapter and SDK-adjacent helper surface involved in this PR.
